purpose: Design of the agent-review backend SKILL: a stateless availability check for the read-only reviewer custom Agent, its tool constraints, the retains_context declaration, and test design.
summary: Overview: agent-review is a review backend SKILL whose only duty is the availability check; /forge:review launches reviewer directly
Architecture and component responsibilities of the agent-review SKILL, reviewer Agent, and /forge:review body
Reviewer Agent definition: allowed tools Read, Grep, Glob, Bash; no Write, Edit, Agent or Skill launch; plan permission mode
Read-only git inquiry allowlist (status, diff, show, log, merge-base) and prohibited mutating operations
Rationale for permitting general command execution and the limits of prompt and tool constraints as a read-only guarantee
Availability check conditions 1 to 5 covering definition, tools, model and permission mode, role rules, and required scripts and documents
Result format: available flag, missing entries with axis, detail and remedy; no side effects; no fallback to another backend
retains_context is always false because each round starts a fresh reviewer; must match resolve_review_backend.py
State and resources: no sessions, transcripts, history, DB records, or daemon processes retained
Test design: lint for text and frontmatter checks, contract test for the declaration match
tasks: Implementing or modifying the agent-review backend SKILL
Changing the reviewer custom Agent definition or its tool permissions
Implementing the availability check for the reviewer backend
Reviewing review backend selection and retains_context handling
Writing lint or contract tests for the agent-review backend
Designing a new review backend alternative
Reviewing design documents related to the review workflow
title: DES-072 agent-review バックエンド設計
